snippet.title: Volume.art - Release Trailer
snippet.description:
Available for free at https://volume.art/

Volume.art is a collaborative project hosted by Mike, where a group of developers try to make a bunch of weird/unique volume sliders for fun.

The end result is a collection of bizarre and questionable volume control systems, where players try to go through them all!
